messages.subject: Schedule of loss — backup for the line-stop and LD figures
messages.plaintextBody:
Grace,

To finalise the schedule I need the supporting backup for two heads: the 14 working days of Bay 4 line-stop at £21,500/day (the idle-time log), and the £412,000 Caldera LD exposure (the relevant clause and the three slipped shipsets). These are the two heads Ferncliffe will attack hardest, so the contemporaneous evidence matters.

James

James Osei
Senior Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
T +44 (0)20 7946 0034

messages.subject: RE: Schedule of loss — backup for the line-stop and LD figures
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

The Bay 4 idle-time log confirms 14 working days; the £21,500/day is our standard fixed-overhead under-recovery rate for that cell, audited. The £412k is three CM-7 shipsets that slipped past the contractual dates, LDs at 0.5%/week under the Caldera MSA. Idris has the Northvale replacement-bar invoices showing the £38/kg premium (£178,220 on 4,690kg).

Grace
Group Finance Director | Halstead Aerospace
